subject: Request: Executive decision — Hosted API usage discount >20% for BlueRiver
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: BlueRiver — ask for exec decision on hosted usage concession (>20%)

Neha / Marcus,

Quick summary: BlueRiver (clinical trials platform) is asking for a deeper-than-usual Hosted API usage discount to accelerate a multi-region pilot that could scale to a 10M token/month run-rate within 9–12 months. Procurement (Claire Zhang) has asked for a 25% off published Hosted API usage rate for the first 12 months, citing competitive pressures and a multi-account rollout.

Why I think it's worth escalating:
- Fast follow-on upside: We have a signed letter of intent and a promise to run an expanded pilot if they hit the agreed technical SLAs.
- Reference potential: strategic customer in oncology vertical with enterprise partners (could surface more enterprise opportunities).
- Committed onboarding: they will do a 12-month pilot with a 6-month ramp and are open to prepay/commit if we require it.

Numbers:
- Current ask: 25% off Hosted API usage rates for 12 months (then revert to list or 10% ongoing).
- Baseline model (attached): with a 12-month committed ramp + 3-month prepay, unit economics are soft but acceptable if we get minimum 6-month retention. Marcus, I flagged the modeled P&L in the attached PDF.

Ask: I need executive confirmation on whether we can approve up to 25% for year one under conditions (prepay or 12-month firm commit + playbook with solutions). If exec wants a lower approval threshold we should specify (e.g., approve up to 22% w/ prepay).

Attachments: BlueRiver_MOU_20280520.pdf; BR_usage_projection_q3q4.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) Finance/pricing to confirm lowest acceptable concession and required guardrails.
2) Legal to prep term amendment that limits exposure (usage caps, rollback period).
3) Exec sign-off if concession >20% is acceptable.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueRiver — ask for exec decision on hosted usage concession (>20%)

Thanks Ben — good write-up.

Two quick requests before I escalate to Mina:
- Marcus: can you confirm the minimum acceptable concession and the cash/commit conditions that make a 25% discount tolerable from a finance POV (pref in the next 24 hours)? If we can only tolerate 22% with prepay, say so clearly.
- Ben: please confirm whether BlueRiver is willing to sign a 12-month minimum commit and whether they will prepay at least Q1 to help de-risk.

I also want Legal to limit any open-ended exposure (rollback after 12 months, token caps, per-account cutoffs). I will loop Mina for exec sign-off once I have finance's guidance.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueRiver — ask for exec decision on hosted usage concession (>20%)

Neha / Ben,

Reviewed the projections and the LOI. Attached is a short model (BR_fin_model_22pct.pdf) showing margin impact. Key points:
- With a 12-month firm commit and at least a Q1 prepay covering ~30% of expected first-year tokens, finance can support up to a 22% concession while keeping NRR targets within range.
- Anything >22% materially increases our cash-burn exposure absent additional contractual protections (hard caps and rollback clauses).

Recommendation for exec ask:
- Approve up to 22% if customer commits 12 months + Q1 prepay + signed SLA/cutover milestones.
- If Sales requests 25%, escalate to Mina (CEO/CRO) for one-time discretionary approval with the above guardrails and an ROI re-check at month 6.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Marcus Lin
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2028 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Executive decision requested — BlueRiver Hosted API concession (25% request)

Mina,

Forwarding the thread and the finance model. Quick tl;dr:
- BlueRiver is asking for 25% off our Hosted API usage price for the first 12 months to win a multi-account pilot that could scale to ~10M tokens/month within a year.
- Finance recommends approving up to 22% with conditions (12-month commit + Q1 prepay + milestone SLAs).
- Sales is asking that we consider a discretionary one-time 25% concession to secure the customer and potential downstream enterprise expansions.

Question: do you approve a one-time executive exception to grant 25% for year one under the following conditions?
1) 12-month minimum commitment in the contract (non-cancellable).
2) Prepay covering at least Q1 (or equivalent deposit) on signature.
3) Formal rollout milestones with rollback to 10% discount if usage does not meet the agreed ramp.
4) Legal to add hard caps and audit rights; product to provide onboarding support.

I can get a signed amendment drafted and the HubSpot deal updated immediately upon your green light. If you prefer, we can instead approve 22% immediately and reserve 25% for a post-signature executive review at month 3.
